title: Tidepool Sort
description: Gather matching shells into the same tide pool. Tap a pool to lift its top shells, then tap another pool to drop them. Shells can land on an empty pool or on shells of the same kind, and each pool holds four. 30 tide pools grow from three kinds of shells to seven, and later pools leave you only one spare. Earn up to three stars by sorting in few moves, with undo, hint and restart when you get stuck. Plays fully offline and saves your progress on the device.
gameplay: Move stacks of shells between tide pools until every pool holds a single kind.
tagline: Sort sea shells into tide pools across 30 relaxing puzzles.
release_notes:
First release:
- 30 tide pools, from three kinds of shells up to seven
- Up to three stars per pool
- Undo, hint and restart
- Plays fully offline
developer_note: Tidepool Sort is a small, quiet puzzle about putting things where they belong. Every pool is generated from a fixed seed and checked by a solver, so each one can be finished. There are no ads and no purchases; the game plays offline and keeps your progress on your device.
features: Up to three stars per pool
